reward_definitions.task_success: submitted is true AND the whole final answer is REFUND_SUBMITTED amount_cents=<the episode amount>, allowing only outer whitespace and trailing special tokens
reward_definitions.N_invalid: Preliminary, pending an agreed penalty definition. N_invalid counts malformed_syntax fragments plus parsed calls whose validation is missing_name, unknown_tool, or schema_invalid. A complete call omitted by the native parser is not a model syntax error and is not counted. truncated_fragment, generation_truncated, no_tool_call, tool_error, exception, order_or_token, and timeout are reported separately and are not counted. C is preliminary.

parse_rule: The native parser is unchanged. parsed means it returned one or more calls; no_tool_call means it returned none. Diagnostic categories are separate: malformed_syntax is a finished attempt that does not parse into a call; omitted_by_native_parser is a syntactically complete call the native parser did not return and is not a syntax error; truncated_fragment is an unfinished attempt. schema_invalid is a validation result. generation_truncated is an independent generation flag and may occur together with any category.

parser_format.supported_format: Pinned AgentTune _parse_cohere_json returns the first JSON value that is a tool_name object or a list made entirely of tool_name objects. A complete list is one value, so every object in it is returned. A bare object is also accepted. A list such as [2, 3] is not a call. A truncated list does not decode, so the scanner returns only the first later complete object and drops later complete siblings. The fallback prompt in the same pinned file tells the model to reply with only a JSON list, one object per call, and to use a list even for one call.

loop.execute: contract.execute.reject_or_run, called by the guarded tools the loop passes to _run_tools_parallel
loop.raw_output: TransformersRolloutEngine.generate return value, including the final generation; the parser result is stored separately
loop.max_steps_counts: In the pinned AgentTune commit, _execute_trajectory counts max_steps as iterations of `while tool_calls and iteration_num < max_steps`. Each iteration executes calls that were already parsed. The first generation happens before the loop. After an iteration, iteration_num is incremented and the loop breaks when iteration_num >= max_steps, before another in-loop generation. If the last message is a tool result, one final generation runs outside that loop and is not part of max_steps. force_final_answer is false, so it adds no generation. max_steps=4 therefore holds four sequential tool calls plus the final answer. The limit was not changed.

tool_result_format:
Tool result for {name}: {content}
This is an observation. You may continue with more tool calls. Take arguments of a dependent call only from observations you have already received. Do not put a dependent call in the same response as the call whose result it needs. After submit_refund is confirmed, the final answer must be exactly REFUND_SUBMITTED amount_cents=<integer>.
previous_tool_result_format:
Tool result for {name}: {content}
Use this result to answer the original question.

The loop stringifies the guard's return value after the structured result is stored. Its tool_failure_count only sees a dict that still contains an 'error' key, so the contract log uses the structured result.
The loop does not parse the final generation after a tool result. That raw completion is saved from generate(), and the diagnostic classification does not execute it.
Step.thought is stored only as loop_step_thought. raw_output is the generation-engine string.
The tokenizer chat template ignores tools=. Schemas reach the model only through tools_fallback_prompt text appended to the system message.
